**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)

Summary: Every link from gentells.com to the Signal Observatory should open in a new tab, so the site stays open behind it.

The Observatory links (nav, mobile menu, account page) open in the same tab today. Asked: `target="_blank"` with `rel="noopener"` on each of them.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Links to the Observatory open in a new tab
